title: Composition of proper derived direct images on quasi-coherent complexes
statement: Let $Z$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes. On the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of quasi-coherent sheaves, there is a canonical natural isomorphism $R(g\circ f)_*\cong Rg_*\circ Rf_*$. The isomorphisms are unital and associative for a further proper morphism.

source.place: Tag 0ATX, Lemma 48.16.3 (composition of upper shriek), proof: the proper direct-image composition

proof.text: By [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint], $Lf^*$ is left adjoint to $Rf_*$ and $Lg^*$ is left adjoint to $Rg_*$ on the unbounded derived categories. By [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], $Lf^*\circ Lg^*\cong L(g\circ f)^*$; transporting the adjunction $L(g\circ f)^*\dashv R(g\circ f)_*$ along this isomorphism, $R(g\circ f)_*$ is a right adjoint of $Lf^*\circ Lg^*$. Applying [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition] with $F=Lg^*$, $G=Lf^*$, $F^!=Rg_*$, $G^!=Rf_*$ and $(G\circ F)^!=R(g\circ f)_*$ gives a canonical natural isomorphism $R(g\circ f)_*\cong Rg_*\circ Rf_*$ on $D(\mathcal O_X)$ (Stacks Tag 0D5T). Since $X$, $Y$, $Z$ are Noetherian, [lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint] says $Rf_*$, $Rg_*$ and $R(g\circ f)_*$ preserve $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$, so the isomorphism restricts to the full subcategories $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Properness and finite type are not used.

source.place: Tag 0D5T, proof using Tag 079W and Tag 0D5S

proof.text: The unit case and the associativity case come from the corresponding coherence of derived pullbacks in [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]: $L(\mathrm{id})^*\cong\mathrm{id}$ compatibly with the composition isomorphisms, and the two ways of identifying $Lf^*\circ Lg^*\circ Lh^*$ with $L(h\circ g\circ f)^*$ agree. The isomorphisms of step 1 are the conjugates (mates) of these pullback isomorphisms, characterised by [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition] through the pasted units and counits; conjugation is compatible with composition and identities, so the unit and associativity equations for the pullbacks give those for the direct images.
